name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
shortDescription: Read-only and transactional querying, schema inspection, table analysis, and performance tuning for PostgreSQL databases.
longDescription: Connect your AI assistant to PostgreSQL databases for automated data exploration, SQL schema analysis, table relationships, safe query execution, and migration generation.
author: modelcontextprotocol

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query on the connected PostgreSQL database.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all schemas and tables in the PostgreSQL database.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get detailed column types, primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes for a table.

prerequisites: Running PostgreSQL instance with accessible network/localhost connection

installSteps.title: Configure Connection URI
installSteps.description: Provide your database connection string as the last argument in your MCP server configuration.

examples.title: Inspect Schema
examples.prompt: Show me the tables in this database and describe the relationship between users and orders.

examples.title: Analyze Data
examples.prompt: Write and run a query to find the top 5 most active users in the last 30 days.
